title: Apache Kylin OLAP Modeling and Cube Index Documentation

sources.notes: Official Kylin model introduction defining dimensions, measures, pre-computation, indexes/CUBEs, aggregate indexes, table indexes, and model/index/data-loading workflow.
Official manual modeling guide covering fact tables, dimension/lookup tables, star and snowflake models, join relations, dimensions, measures, and loading configuration.
Official measures reference for SUM, MAX, MIN, COUNT, TopN, exact and approximate count distinct, approximate percentile, and measure creation boundaries.
Official computed-column modeling reference; computed columns can participate in dimensions and measures and require expression-level review.
Official SCD2 feature reference for non-equi joins and historical dimension handling; useful bridge from Kimball SCD vocabulary to OLAP implementation.
Quickstart SSB dataset and examples are useful for modeling context but dataset/code bytes require separate file and license review before caching or indexing.
Screenshots, GIFs, UI assets, embedded SVGs, SQL snippets, and linked code-like artifacts are mapped as boundaries until extraction policy is reviewed.
